exact_statement: For each of the eight essential binary Boolean sign gates with one exceptional truth-table corner, the supremum over all interior independent Bernoulli biases of corrected Hplus/(I-Var) is exactly 2+4/ln(2). For XOR and XNOR the supremum is exactly 2/ln(2). The suprema are not attained in the interior. Writing A(x)=x ln(1/x)/(1-x), corner ratios are 2+2[A(u)+A(v)]/ln(2), where u,v are probabilities of the exceptional corner coordinates; parity ratios are [A(1-4p(1-p))+A(1-4q(1-q))]/ln(2). These formulas extend as limits of interior ratios along arbitrary independent endpoint rates, while deterministic contracted functions have Hplus=I-Var=0. The common sharp corrected constant 2+4/ln(2) propagates through genuine read-once binary formulas under every product physical law by exact disjoint composition; on uniform physical inputs it implies ordinary H<= [2+4/ln(2)] I. No higher-arity prime or universal FEI estimate is established.
